case.background: A freshly isolated radioactive product is sealed in identical holders and observed with a shielded counter. Vary elapsed time and sample mass, then infer how the measured activity changes.
initial_observations: The count rate decreases after isolation even though the holder remains sealed.
A separately measured background remains present at late times.

controls.description: Elapsed time since the sample was chemically isolated.

controls.description: Mass of the isolated radioactive product in the holder.

instruments.description: Identical sealed sample holders, a shielded radiation counter, a timer, and a separately calibrated background.

notes: Each holder remains sealed; detector geometry and background are unchanged.
